info.title: Mobix API
info.description: Ride sharing with individual rider, driver, and operator accounts, nearby driver offers, and simulated receipts.

post.description: Exchange individual account credentials for a 12-hour bearer session.

503.description: Redis is unavailable, so login protection cannot be enforced

get.description: Read the current signed-in account identity and role.

post.description: Operator only. Create an individual rider, driver or operator account.

429.description: Authentication hashing capacity is busy. Retry shortly.

409.description: Email already belongs to an account

get.description: Check whether the gateway is serving requests.
Check HTTP readiness of the trip, driver and payment services and their databases.

post.description: Driver only. Register one profile linked to your authenticated account. Contact email, phone and license plate must be unique.

201.description: Resource created or previous trip returned

409.description: A driver already uses the same email, phone or license plate

401.description: A valid, unexpired account session is required

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

403.description: The account role is not allowed to perform this action

get.description: Read your own driver profile, or read any profile as an operator.

400.description: Malformed ID or invalid request fields

401.description: A valid, unexpired account session is required

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

403.description: The account role is not allowed to perform this action

patch.description: Driver only. Update your own declared availability. An active trip remains owned by the trip service.

400.description: Malformed ID or invalid request fields

401.description: A valid, unexpired account session is required

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

403.description: The account role is not allowed to perform this action

patch.description: Driver only. Update your own most recent GPS location.

400.description: Malformed ID or invalid request fields

401.description: A valid, unexpired account session is required

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

403.description: The account role is not allowed to perform this action

get.description: Read your own effective driver status and completed trip count, or read any driver activity as an operator.

400.description: Malformed ID or invalid request fields

401.description: A valid, unexpired account session is required

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

403.description: The account role is not allowed to perform this action

post.description: Rider only. The authenticated account supplies rider_id. A new trip starts automatic driver matching. Idempotency-Key is scoped to this rider. The response includes an estimated fare in USD cents.

201.description: Resource created or previous trip returned

409.description: This rider already used the retry key with different trip details

401.description: A valid, unexpired account session is required

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

403.description: The account role is not allowed to perform this action

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional retry key scoped to the authenticated rider. Reuse the same key and trip details after a timeout.

get.description: Read a trip as its rider, its assigned driver, or an operator. Inaccessible trips return 404.

400.description: Malformed ID or invalid request fields

401.description: A valid, unexpired account session is required

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

403.description: The account role is not allowed to perform this action

patch.description: Operators can assign a driver manually. Only the assigned driver starts or completes a trip. Riders and operators may cancel requested or assigned trips. Cancellation closes all open offers.

400.description: Malformed ID or invalid request fields

409.description: Driver is unavailable, already assigned, or the resource changed

422.description: This transition is invalid for the current trip status

401.description: A valid, unexpired account session is required

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

403.description: The account role is not allowed to perform this action

get.description: Read the simulated receipt as the trip owner or an operator. Receipts are asynchronous. Inaccessible trips return 404.

400.description: Malformed ID or invalid request fields

404.description: Trip is inaccessible or its receipt is still pending

401.description: A valid, unexpired account session is required

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

403.description: The account role is not allowed to perform this action

get.description: Driver only. Retrieve the profile linked to your signed-in account.

401.description: A valid, unexpired account session is required

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

403.description: The account role is not allowed to perform this action

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream for the trip owner, assigned driver, or an operator. The first event is an authorized `snapshot`; newer versioned ride events follow. Heartbeat comments keep idle connections alive. Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID`; every connection still receives a fresh snapshot, so missed broker notifications cannot create a state gap.

200.description: SSE stream beginning with the current trip snapshot

401.description: A valid account session is required

404.description: The trip is unknown or inaccessible

503.description: The upstream snapshot or stream capacity is unavailable

get.description: Poll as a signed-in driver to see your own pending offers. Assigned, cancelled, expired, and declined offers leave the inbox.

200.description: Up to 50 pending offers ordered by deadline

401.description: A valid account session is required

403.description: Only signed-in drivers can access ride offers

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

get.description: Server-Sent Events stream for a signed-in driver. It starts with the current offer-inbox snapshot and then emits versioned notifications when this driver's offers or assigned trips change. Audience identifiers used for server-side routing are never included in client events.

200.description: SSE stream beginning with the current offer-inbox snapshot

401.description: A valid account session is required

403.description: Only signed-in drivers can open this stream

503.description: The upstream snapshot or stream capacity is unavailable

post.description: Only the invited driver can accept. The first valid acceptance assigns the ride. Retrying the winning offer returns the current trip while the ride is assigned, in progress, or completed.

401.description: A valid account session is required

403.description: Only signed-in drivers can access ride offers

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

404.description: The offer is unknown to this driver

409.description: Offer expired, closed, or taken, or the driver already has an active ride

post.description: Decline your own offer. When the whole batch declines, matching can advance immediately.

401.description: A valid account session is required

403.description: Only signed-in drivers can access ride offers

503.description: A required service is temporarily unavailable

404.description: The offer is unknown to this driver

version.description: Monotonic revision of client-visible trip state. Legacy trips start at zero.

RateLimited.description: The endpoint-specific account or IP quota, or bounded authentication capacity, is exhausted

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the token bucket can admit another request

accountSession.description: Opaque access token returned by POST /v1/auth/login. Sessions expire after 12 hours and can be revoked with POST /v1/auth/logout.
